This smartphone UI screen displays a Bible verse from Luke 5:27-39. The text of the verse is shown in the main part of the screen. At the top, there is a back arrow to return to the previous screen, the title "Verse," and a share icon. 

Below the verse, there is a "Share" section with various sharing options, including:
- Facebook

- Android Beam
